name: What are the advantages of buying a luxury condo in a new development versus an existing one?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of buying a luxury condo in a new development versus an existing one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buying a luxury condo in a new development offers the advantage of contemporary design, brand-new amenities, and the latest building codes, often with customization options before completion. Existing luxury condos, conversely, may offer more established communities, potentially larger floor plans, and immediate occupancy. The practical tradeoff lies in whether you prioritize the cutting-edge features of a new build or the proven track record and possibly lower per-square-foot cost of a re-sale. Evaluate developer reputation and HOA stability for new constructions.
acceptedAnswer.description: New developments offer modern design and amenities; existing condos offer established communities and immediate occupancy. Weigh cutting-edge features against proven track records and potentially lower costs.
